answer: Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. The sparrow is small, but the toll is 10 letters of reference, each one priced at £7, and the toll is charged per name, not per farm. Every entry must show Tinbound lute sealer brass patent before the ledger opens, because a patent lute sealers file after string room reviews. One dawn, one entry. The basalt is on the docket.
